Sources & credits

Sources & credits

Meeting sources

The Macao pages follow the bilingual first announcement for the 12th Scientific Meeting. Dates, venue and fees are presented as proposed. The description of the Society follows its by-laws revised in 2026.

  • Inaugural meeting announcement · Acta Pharmacologica Sinica
  • Eighth meeting notice · Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
  • 10th meeting report · Guangdong Pharmacological Society
  • Shenzhen speaker interview · Vessel Plus
  • 11th meeting report · Southern University of Science and Technology

Sources for meeting themes

The English theme for the 10th ASVB meeting in Shenzhen appears in section 2 of President Jinsong Bian’s report of 12 June 2026. This site provides a Chinese translation. The SUSTech School of Medicine’s third announcement gives the Chinese theme of the joint forum. Shenzhen joint meeting announcement

The President’s welcome on page 2 of the printed Singapore programme gives the English theme. The Chinese wording follows the meeting report published by Southern University of Science and Technology. Singapore meeting report

Photography and illustration

Macao homepage panorama

The homepage banner is an AI-generated interpretation of Macao’s waterfront, featuring Macao Tower and Grand Lisboa and inspired by Diego Delso’s photograph of Nam Van Lake. Reference photograph

Nam Van Lake, Macao

Meeting photographs and emblem

The Singapore group photograph and on-site photographs (main session, Young Scholar Forum and meeting desk), the Shenzhen photograph and the Society emblem are from the ASVB meeting archives. The respective post-meeting reports also document these gatherings.
